import Sub from "./subReLearn"
import Custom from "./customComponent"
import "./ReLearn.css"

import { useRef } from "react"
import { useState } from "react"

export default function() {

  const ref = useRef(0)
  return <>
  <button
  onClick={() => {ref.current = ref.current + 1; alert(ref.current)}}
  >{ref.current}</button>
  </>
}
